issue_definitions.multiple_history_triage_values: A single raw JSON contains more than one distinct history[].triage value.
issue_definitions.history_triage_mode_mismatch_gt_acuity: The most frequent history[].triage value differs from ground_truth.acuity.
issue_definitions.history_triage_contains_3_in_non_gt3_cas: A non-GT3 case contains turn-level triage=3, which may pull downstream predictions toward ESI3 if leaked.
issue_definitions.history_triage_value_not_in_1_to_5: A history[].triage value is outside the expected acuity range.
